name: arrogance
quote: He never lets me forget how smart he is.
description: A perception that someone treats others as being of undeservedly less social status than themselves.
perceptions: That person talks or acts like they have more social status than I think they deserve.
They treat me or others as being lower than them.
examples: Attractive model acts above ordinary people due to her looks alone.
Bully thinks the rules don't apply to him.
Guy at the bar endlessly brags about his great life.

guidance.description: How do you deal with somebody that is too confident? I've got five tools for you.

variations.name: hubris
variations.description: A perception that someone made an important mistake despite thinking highly of themselves in that area.
perceptions: That person talks or acts like they're a better person because they're good at something.
Yet they just make a big mistake.
examples: Basketball star hogs the ball but misses the shot to lose the game.
Daedalus flies too close to the sun.

guidance.description: Even the most skilled and talented individuals must be mindful of their limitations and the consequences of their actions. If you're working with a hubristic leader, it's important to recognize their behaviors and take steps to handle the situation effectively.

commentaries.quote: When someone acts like they have more social status than we think they deserve, we can react like it's a form of cheating.

Hubris, arrogance, is just one step ahead of loss of integrity, because if you think you're better than other people, you know more, then you're going to think, as many leaders have, that the rules don't apply to them - so they lose their integrity.
I had to choose early in my life between an honest arrogance and a hypocritical humility and I deliberately chose an honest arrogance.
It's only hubris if I fail.
Hubris is one of the great renewable resources.

A confident individual has high self-worth and therefore, is unbothered by bragging or boasting about their achievements. An arrogant individual often has an inflated sense of their self-importance and is never satisfied. They feel the need to boast as they are, in actual fact, not happy with their external persona.

1.description: When the over-confident fail, there may be an element of satisfaction.
